title: Every nuclear test, mapped
excerpt: Since 1945 eight countries have set off 2,055 nuclear tests. I mapped every one: 178 in 1962 alone, most of them underground after 1963, and 84% of all the explosive yield on islands.
seo_description: Every nuclear test since 1945 mapped: 2,055 tests by eight countries, the 1962 peak, the move underground, and whose land they were on.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Every nuclear test' in black and red on pale paper, beside a world map with circles at every nuclear test site, sized by yield and coloured by country: large red circles on Novaya Zemlya, blue on the Pacific atolls and Nevada, gold at Lop Nur. Text: 2,055 tests by eight countries, 1945 to 2017; 178 in 1962 alone; 84% of all the explosive yield was set off on islands.
